title: Hunts FH-031U: Put the finale seat check inside the reward grant, credit the Event stop at the door, and queue the finale notice

source.ref: Split from FH-031T (2026-11-23): the author's Event picker and the app-side seat check on the grant route shipped dark; the database and door halves move here.

detail: Owed after FH-031T. (1) Game systems with the database owner: hunt_reward_grant gets the same seat check the app makes (lib/hunts/finale-store.ts grantRunReward, lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts grantFinaleReward), so the rule does not rest on one caller: on a Hunt whose version names a finale Event, a completion reward is granted only to a caller with a succeeded, unrefunded ticket or a going RSVP at that Event, else it answers not_admitted (lib/hunts/rewards.ts already words that answer) and writes nothing. A migration through the serialized gate, with a pgTAP test; a draft written against 20270346042000_hunt_rewards.sql sits on branch claude/project-thread-remkyp-finale-sql and must be re-read against the function on main before it is used. (2) An Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door. (3) A producer that queues the finale notice in the Hunt outbox with finaleBroadcastAggregate(eventId), which route health already counts. (4) Web: a control on the player's Trail page that calls POST /api/hunts/rewards/grant; today no screen does. (5) Operator: on a preview deployment, a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Done when: a completion reward cannot be granted by any caller to a player the host Event does not admit. Requires: FH-031T. Owner role: Game systems, with the database owner. Hunts switches stay OFF.
